﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: google-api-services-translate v2-rev20170525-2.0.0 -> v3-rev20220805-2.0.0

`com.google.apis:google-api-services-translate` from `v2-rev20170525-2.0.0` to `v3-rev20220805-2.0.0` (other update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/googleapis/google-cloud-java/pull/8188

## Your Task

The source code is in `/google-cloud-java`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll start by understanding the compilation errors and then fix them. Let me first run `mvn compile` to see what errors we're dealing with.

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
  <groupId>com.google.cloud</groupId>

  <organization>
    <name>Google LLC</name>
  </organization>
  <scm>
    <connection>scm:git:git@github.com:googleapis/java-translate.git</connection>
    <developerConnection>scm:git:git@github.com:googleapis/java-translate.git</developerConnection>
    <url>https://github.com/googleapis/java-translate</url>
    <tag>HEAD</tag>
  </scm>
  <issueManagement>
    <url>https://github.com/googleapis/java-translate/issues</url>
    <system>GitHub Issues</system>
  </issueManagement>

  <licenses>
    <license>
      <name>Apache-2.0</name>
      <url>https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt</url>
    </license>
  </licenses>

  <properties>
    <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>

    <site.installationModule>google-cloud-translate-parent</site.installationModule>
  </properties>

  <dependencyManagement>
    <dependencies>
      <dependency>
        <groupId>com.google.api.grpc</groupId>

      </dependency>
      <dependency>
        <groupId>com.google.api.grpc</groupId>
        <artifactId>proto-google-cloud-translate-v3</artifactId>

      </dependency>
      <dependency>
        <groupId>com.google.api.grpc</groupId>
        <artifactId>grpc-google-cloud-translate-v3beta1</artifactId>

      </dependency>
      <dependency>
        <groupId>com.google.api.grpc</groupId>
        <artifactId>grpc-google-cloud-translate-v3</artifactId>
        <version>2.3.4</version><!-- {x-version-update:grpc-google-cloud-translate-v3:current} -->
      </dependency>
      <dependency>
        <groupId>com.google.cloud</groupId>
        <artifactId>google-cloud-translate</artifactId>
        <version>2.3.4</version><!-- {x-version-update:google-cloud-translate:current} -->

        <groupId>com.google.cloud</groupId>
        <artifactId>google-cloud-shared-dependencies</artifactId>

        <scope>import</scope>
      </dependency>
      <dependency>
        <groupId>com.google.apis</groupId>
        <artifactId>google-api-services-translate</artifactId>
        <version>v3-rev20220805-2.0.0</version>

        <groupId>junit</groupId>
        <artifactId>junit</artifactId>
        <version>4.13.2</version>
        <scope>test</scope>
